description: Day 15. The moment Yudhishthira tells the half-lie: 'Ashwatthama is dead... the elephant.' Drona's grief causes him to lower his weapons. The climax of the Drona Parva.

tile_overrides.note: Drona stands here when the lie is spoken. He lays down his weapons.

special_mechanics.dharma_crisis: If the player chooses NOT to tell the lie, Drona remains invincible (acharya trait causes DiscipleHesitation for Pandavas). fail_on_deviation: uncertain. The lie is adharmic but necessary.
special_mechanics.drona_disarms: After the lie, Drona's defense drops to 0 for 1 turn. Dhrishtadyumna (agni-putra + drona-killer traits) must strike the killing blow.
